label: Deterministic keyword baseline; not AI and not an evaluated taxonomy

controls_usability.customer_outcome: Occupants can complete frequently used control tasks with low visual and manual effort.

software_reliability.customer_outcome: Occupants can rely on vehicle software and connected functions to work consistently during normal use.

charging_and_range.customer_outcome: Electric-vehicle users can complete intended journeys and charging stops with predictable effort.

ride_and_comfort.customer_outcome: Occupants remain comfortable in their seating position and intended journey conditions.

noise_and_refinement.customer_outcome: Occupants experience an appropriately quiet and refined cabin in the stated driving conditions.

storage_and_practicality.customer_outcome: Occupants can carry and organize everyday items needed for intended journeys.

driver_assistance.customer_outcome: Drivers can use assistance functions predictably without avoidable supervision burden.
